environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task but deployed via the organization's hardened container baseline. The task definition specifies a custom AppArmor profile loaded via ECS agent configuration (ecsAgent.appendix.apparmor_profile = 'notification-consumer-confined'). The profile denies all file write operations except to /var/log/app/audit.log and /tmp/. Additionally, the profile includes a network mediation clause that uses 'deny network inet dgram' and 'deny network inet stream connect to 169.254.0.0/16' preventing connections to link-local addresses. The container also runs with a read-only root filesystem with tmpfs mounted only at /tmp. Note: the AppArmor profile was last audited Q3 2024 and the network mediation rules use the 'owner' qualifier for conditional matching on socket ownership.

apparmor_rules: deny network inet stream connect to 169.254.0.0/16,
deny network inet6 stream connect to fe80::/10,
